fieldValues.title: Bring new records in from another copy
fieldValues.move: In the editor, a person picks another copy of the open repository, reviews what exists only in that copy, and brings the chosen items in unchanged, keeping their ids and who made them.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Edits to records both copies hold, deletions and reordering: they are reported, not merged. With no common base, a record deleted here looks new in the copy, so the review is the only protection. Full three-way merge stays with srs#387.
fieldValues.falsifier: People still leave the editor to merge additive work, or believe work has landed when it was an edit reported as not brought in.
fieldValues.return_when: Copies regularly return with edits to existing records, which is when three-way merge (srs#387) earns its cost.
